name: setup_env
description: Manage the named Nix environments dispatched agents run in, so an agent can build and TEST its work rather than only edit files. Environments are shared and curated: hit a missing library once, add it once, and every later dispatch has it. Call after bind_repo and before dispatch_agent. Actions: 'detect' (what this repo appears to need — read-only), 'list' (all environments), 'use' (attach this workstream to one, bootstrapping from the repo when no name is given), 'add' (add packages to the attached environment), 'status' (what is attached), 'detach'.

action.description: What to do. 'detect' and 'list' are read-only.

name.description: Environment name for 'use'. Omit to bootstrap one named after the bound repo. Reuse a name (e.g. 'go-dev') to share one environment across repos.

packages.description: Exact nixpkgs attribute names, e.g. ['ffmpeg', 'postgresql']. Used by 'add', and by 'use' to seed a new environment.
